target.notes: Round-1 reconciled symbols from ghidra/proposals/*.verified.json (core, hw1-match, lib-graph, lib-strings, missions, ships, sim-cataclysm, sim-presentation, sim-universe), audited sets only; qwen-naming.json (unaudited) excluded. Class in notes as class=<crt|won|bink|rgl|unknown|cat-new|hw1:File.c>; class-only library carvings are named lib_<class>_<addr> (lib=magick|ijg|cms for unknown-class library blocks). C++ qualified names are flattened (A::B -> A__B) with the original in qualified=. CET names (cet_symbols.json) are never replaced without two independent high-confidence sets. See ghidra/proposals/reconcile_report.md.
